run_sam3d_body_demo: run the SAM 3D Body demo on a folder of images to recover human meshes
run_demo_with_mask: run the demo with mask-conditioned prediction by passing the --use_mask flag
run_demo_custom_detector: run the demo with a custom human detector by setting --detector_name and --detector_path
run_demo_custom_segmentor: run the demo with a custom segmentor by setting --segmentor_name and --segmentor_path
run_demo_custom_fov: run the demo with a custom FOV estimator by setting --fov_name and --fov_path
